item.description:
Release v5.1.1

Changes since v5.1.0

  • feat(AgentTurnNotificationPlugin): add SuperLog, overlay view and enable alwaysOn policy
  • feat(caffeinate): register menu bar popup view
  • feat(conversation-list): show bound LLM provider/model on third line
  • feat(conversation-speed): show popover explaining last message TPS
  • feat(conversation-store): show message list below selected conversation detail
  • feat(conversation): integrate ConversationLanguagePlugin and refine conversation APIs
  • feat(conversation): support updating conversation title via ConversationManaging
  • feat(docx-read): activate DocxReadPlugin with read_docx agent tool
  • feat(editor-provider): implement replaceEditorPlugins for atomic extension replacement
  • feat(editor-provider): render real editor via SourceEditor
  • feat(editor-swift): adapt Swift highlighting plugin to kernel
  • feat(kernel): add daily aggregate queries to MessageManaging
  • feat(kernel): add EditorPlugin typed contribution point via LumiPlugin.editorPlugins
  • feat(kernel): add highlight contributor injection point via EditorExtensionRegistrar
  • feat(kernel): expose editor view via EditorProviding.makeEditorView
  • feat(kernel): introduce EditorPlugin and EditorExtensionRegistrar protocols
  • feat(kernel): register editor extensions via EditorPlugin contract
  • feat(layout): replace HStack with nested HSplitView for resizable columns
  • feat(memory): add settings view with memory list and detail
  • feat(memory): register memory tools in plugin
